scope: All PRs created in 2025-01-01..2026-06-30 plus older PRs merged in that window; no PR sampling.
file_scope: All aggregate additions/deletions; full file pagination for merged-in-window PRs.
technical_scope: User-approved software systems, apps, libraries and frameworks. Evidence verification stored separately; no claims of semantic classifier accuracy.
ranking_scope: 10 user-approved technical candidates from current star-ranked snapshot, not a proven exhaustive global technical-project ranking.
low_controls: Deferred until these 10 projects are complete and strict technical matching can be established; no automatic use of old metadata-only control selection.

concurrency.scope: non-overlapping time windows within one repository
concurrency.secondary_limit_action: shared cooldown and downgrade to serial
concurrency.trial: Five workers, shared request-start spacing of one second; no time limit.

request_strategy.file_pagination: All merged-in-window PRs, adaptive per-request batch sizes 20/10/5/2/1

stop_policy: No wall-clock deadline or forecast cutoff. Continue through the selected cohort; retain rate-limit waits and integrity/error checks.
export_note: Historical candidate replacements omitted; final selected cohort retained.
